English: Open Table
A rough wooden table, set out on the steppe, where traders and clansfolk meet to barter livestock, grain, and wares.
Barter Patch
A cleared patch of ground, marked by stones and banners, where local clans gather for lively barter and trade.
Traders Tent
A large, colorful tent erected at the heart of the camp, where merchants display goods from distant lands and local craftsmen hawk their wares.
Merchants Pavilion
A grander, more permanent fabric structure, with wooden supports and stalls, attracting traveling merchants and boosting local prosperity.
Market Stand
A row of wooden stands and carts, with awnings and signs, forming the core of a bustling, semi-permanent trading ground.
Exchange Room
A robust wooden hall with guarded doors, benches, and storage for goods—where deals are struck and trade is weighed and measured.
Market Hall
A sturdy timber hall with designated sections for merchants, overseen by clan elders, facilitating large-scale deals and seasonal fairs.
Guild Pavilion
A sprawling wooden and stone structure with storage, guild banners, and designated spaces for artisans, traders, and clan delegates.
Grand Market Room
A grand domed hall, with stone foundations and timber beams, bustling with commerce, guarded by the clans finest, and known across the steppes.
South Slavic Grand Market
A legendary market complex, built of stone and timber, ringed by fortified gates and storerooms, drawing caravans from distant lands and uniting the clans in prosperity.
